posts.author: BigBucket
posts.body:
I am totally new to using RPG Maker MV, just got it yesterday, so I am currently looking into video tutorials and guides to familiarize myself with it. However, the main reason I got MV was because I wanted to try experimenting with its SRPG Gear MV plugin, which I downloaded off of Steam alongside MV if that information is helpful.
My issue with that is that I am struggling to find any sort of tutorial on how to set up and begin using the SRPG Gear MV plugin itself. So I was hoping that I could ask around here, does anyone know of any video tutorials, guides, or threads on these forums that could help me out with getting started on using this plugin? If so I would very much appreciate it if you could share it with me here, thank you!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
The plugin has a thread here:
MV - SRPG Engine MV - Plugins for creating Tactical Battle System
Introducing  credits : Gakuto Mikagami, Doctor_Q https://github.com/Echizen-ham/SRPGcore https://github.com/RyanBram/SRPGcore    Hi, everyone. Do you like Turn Based Strategy RPG games? If so, then I'm also like it so much just like you.  Therefore, on this occasion, let me introduce a...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
I feel it's worth mentioning that it's a pretty technical process. I strongly recommend you spend some time with tutorials for MV and making practice games with how the engine is supposed to work before you try to get into something so complex.
(I'd also mention that if that's very specifically the kind of game you want to make, there are other game-making engines that are actually designed to do it)
